_comment: How far from a designated road dispersed camping is legal, per national forest.
The national MVUM roads dataset has no camping-distance attribute, so these
numbers cannot be derived — each one is read off an official Forest Service
page and cited. Forests absent from this table are buffered at defaultFeet and
marked confidence=default_buffer, which the map draws as an estimate.
Keys must match the MVUM dataset's FORESTNAME field. Matching is done on a
case- and whitespace-normalized form (see engine/legalBuffer.ts), but staying
verbatim keeps this file greppable against the source data.
Adding a forest: find its official dispersed-camping or MVUM page, quote the
distance, put the URL in source and today's date in checked. An entry without
a source is rejected at build time rather than trusted.
